title: Pleated Chiffon Lantern Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
If you want a formal wedding guest dress with sleeves, this one is easy to wear and easy to style. The V-neck wrap front sits well on a fuller bust. The lantern sleeves give real arm coverage without feeling heavy or restrictive. A wide waistband helps define the waist and smooths the midsection, and the high-low chiffon skirt makes walking, sitting, and dancing simpler than a full floor-length gown. The skirt drapes over hips and thighs, so it doesn’t cling.

Best For

  • Formal wedding guest dresses with sleeves

  • Cocktail attire and evening receptions

  • Arm coverage with lantern sleeves

  • Tummy-friendly waist definition

  • Anyone who prefers a high-low hem for easier movement





Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
